fingerprints.note: releaseInstance caches a ready instance then shuts it down; the reader never re-checks isReady
performGeneration appends a second, always-.natural completion after generateTokens already emitted one
generateTokens' five completion emit sites (userCancelled, natural/EOG, stop-sequence-derived, contextWindowFull, maxTokensReached)
publishProgress terminates the loading stream via progress.isComplete. REPAIRED under ODC-0012; the prior gate was an unsatisfiable AND over one value.
handleInitializationError calls cleanup() before attemptFallbackInitialization, so every fallback-path publishProgress is a silent no-op
